<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pp(frame):
    pts=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): pts+=n['boundary']
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None

print("before:", pp(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':45}])
print("after click:", pp(current_frame), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in (31,32,33,34,35,36):
    row=lines[r]; runs=[]; prev=None; start=0
    for c,ch in enumerate(row+'\n'):
        if ch!=prev:
            if prev is not None: runs.append((prev,start,c-1))
            prev=ch; start=c
    print(r, "".join(f"{col}{a}-{b}" for col,a,b in runs if col in 'SNbYW'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pp(frame):
    pts=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'): pts+=n['boundary']
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None

print("before:", pp(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':33,'col':45}])
print("after click:", pp(current_frame), "changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
lines=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
for r in (31,32,33,34,35,36):
    row=lines[r]; runs=[]; prev=None; start=0
    for c,ch in enumerate(row+'\n'):
        if ch!=prev:
            if prev is not None: runs.append((prev,start,c-1))
            prev=ch; start=c
    print(r, "".join(f"{col}{a}-{b}" for col,a,b in runs if col in 'SNbYW'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
